What also struck me was that I couldn't see any real kitchen operation, which only reinforced the impression that much of the food was prepared elsewhere and simply finished on-site.

Had a really good experience at Maki & Ramen in Meadowhall. The food was really good, everything tasted fresh, and the staff were very friendly and helpful.

We ordered the black garlic ramen and the hell ramen, and the flavour was really good. My only comment would be that I felt they could have been a little more generous with the soup, as I would have preferred a bit more broth.

We also ordered the Black Dragon Roll. The flavours were great, but the sauce was a little too thin, so the rice absorbed it quite quickly and became a bit soggy. It’s only a small point, but a slightly thicker sauce would make it even better.

There was also a small mix-up with one of the sushi rolls we ordered. However, as soon as we mentioned it, the staff spoke to the kitchen without hesitation and had the correct one remade for us. They even let us keep the original roll, which was a really nice gesture and showed great customer service.

The only minor downside was that it could sometimes be difficult to find a member of staff when sitting in the lower-level seating area, as there wasn't always someone nearby.

One other thing to note is that the lower-level seating area is accessed by a few stairs rather than a slope. It's only around 3–4 steps, so it’s not a major issue, but people with wheelchairs or strollers might find it a little difficult to access that area.

Overall, it was a great experience with good food and excellent service. There are a few small things that could be improved, but I'd definitely come back again.

Very disappointing experience at Maki & Ramen Meadowhall.

We visited as a family with our very young daughter. Because she would not eat the food from the restaurant, we had brought a small amount of fried chicken for her.

A member of staff told us she could not eat it because of allergy/cross-contamination concerns. If that is the restaurant's policy, we would have been happy to respect it if it had simply been explained politely.

The problem was the way we were spoken to.

The staff member became extremely condescending and started lecturing us, even making a sarcastic comparison along the lines of bringing food for our toddler being like "going to a shoe shop with shoes."

There was absolutely no need to speak to customers like that.

The whole interaction made us feel singled out, embarrassed and unwelcome. We left genuinely questioning why we were treated in such a hostile manner.

Restaurant policies are understandable. Rude and disrespectful treatment of customers, especially a family with a very young child, is not.

I have raised the matter directly with Maki & Ramen management and hope they investigate it properly.

Very disappointing experience at Maki & Ramen Meadowhall on Saturday 15 August, shortly after 6:30 pm.

Restaurant policies are understandable, but customers should still be treated with basic respect.
